ClaudeThoughtBubbleAnimationSystem.SystemOverview: Claude is the loyal Redbone Coonhound companion in the Sir James Interactive Storybook. His role is to silently offer guidance, emotional support, and playful non-verbal reactions through animated thought bubbles that appear during narrative and decision-making moments. This enhances emotional literacy and soft decision hints, especially for younger readers.

AnimationStates.description: Default relaxed state with blinking or nose wiggle
Triggered by narration voice lines (head tilt)
Light sniffing loop during quiet moments
Thought bubble grows from Claude's head
Bubble icon gently pulses to attract attention
Fades once decision is made or dismissed

ThoughtBubbleIconTypes._note: ALL icons are HD DALL-E generated images - NO emojis

HelpfulInsight.dall_e_prompt: Golden glowing lightbulb with small pawprint embossed on glass, soft magical glow, Disney Pixar 3D style, transparent background, 512x512
HelpfulInsight.use_case: When player should choose the kind/brave option

Uncertainty.dall_e_prompt: Soft fluffy cloud shaped like question mark, gentle silver shimmer, curious expression, Disney Pixar 3D style, transparent background, 512x512
Uncertainty.meaning: Encourages player to pause and reflect
Uncertainty.use_case: Complex moral choices, no clear right answer

Empathy.dall_e_prompt: Warm glowing heart with gentle pink and red gradient, soft magical sparkles, caring and kind feeling, Disney Pixar 3D style, transparent background, 512x512
Empathy.use_case: When choice affects another character's feelings

Concern.dall_e_prompt: Gentle amber caution symbol with soft glow, not scary, protective feeling, Disney Pixar 3D style, transparent background, 512x512
Concern.meaning: Warns of selfish or rash choice
Concern.use_case: When player is about to make a poor decision

Joy.dall_e_prompt: Sparkling golden star burst with colorful magical confetti, celebration feeling, happy and bright, Disney Pixar 3D style, transparent background, 512x512

showThought.description: Shows heart bubble with specified type

onClick.description: Triggers voice-over or parent hint tooltip

reset.description: Removes all bubbles and returns to idle

animate.description: Triggers current mood loop (sniff, tail wag, etc.)

BubbleTiming.description: Bubble appears 3 seconds after narration ends

Interaction.tap_action: Optional voice hint or enhanced visual cue

Accessibility.description: Bubbles paired with accessible alt-text for visually impaired readers
